summary: The taxpayer and parent object to E-Rate funding of wifi hotspots in schools, arguing that it misuses funds and creates a lack of supervision over children's internet access. The text discusses the negative impacts of excessive screen time on children, including obesity, mental health issues, and physical health. It argues that E-Rate should condition eligibility on screen-time limits to protect children's privacy and well-being.

claims.evidence_quote: Internet access in school cannot be supervised to the extent that is required to keep children safe. The burden of supervision cannot fall on teachers. It doesn’t work.
